caption:
I’m getting things ready for our letter of the week activity, and I thought I’d share this clip / HACK from last weeks alphabet craft. 

My 5 year old was using his Animal Alphabet Adventure book to work on his tracing, cutting & gluing skills.

While our 2.5 year old worked on an alphabet page I saved from years ago. 

I honestly didn’t think it through as I started to help my 5 year old with his alphabet craft. 

I should’ve helped my 2.5 year old first, since she does get impatient with scissors 😅

Luckily, my mom's brain kicked in, and I decided to glue everything onto a piece of paper so that she can still create her animal alphabet craft.
